concrete.creator: Mercedes Solla; SFCW data provided by Screening Eagle Technologies
concrete.material: Concrete specimens with reinforcing bars; NOT park soil
concrete.processing: Instrument time-domain SEG-Y export. Internal phase/calibration/windowing not fully specified. Local plots subtract profile mean and clip at99th percentile; low-band files add documented cosine filter.
concrete.quantitative_comparison_limit: Different material, antenna and electronics. Shared filter band permits diagnostic comparison only, not A-scan agreement or calibration validation.

profiles.count_note: CSV reports 1.25 m (I), 1.85 m (II/III); inferred endpoints I/II exceed these by 5 mm.
profiles.sample_note: Actual export:655 samples. Article reportedly states653; actual export retained.
profiles.time_zero_note: Time0 is the first exported sample, not a calibrated surface/reflection zero. No shift or depth conversion was applied.
